title: Jubilant Croatian Fideo Noodles
description: A peppery and creamy nostalgic Croatian dish featuring fideo noodles, caramelized onions, and a rich dairy sauce, made keto-friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent and slightly caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the fideo noodles and cherry tomatoes, tossing to combine and letting the tomatoes soften, about 3 minutes.
Pour in the heavy cream, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the sauce thickens, about 4 minutes.
Sprinkle the grated parmesan over the noodles and stir until melted into a creamy coating.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, ensuring the flavors balance the peppery notes of the tomatoes.
Transfer the dish to serving plates and top with fresh basil leaves for a bright finish.
Serve hot for a comforting keto-friendly dinner.
